turns.question: Which channel brought us the most bookings in September 2026, and how many?
turns.answer: The search channel brought the most bookings in September 2026, with 31 bookings (bookings made 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, counted on the day they were made). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
